text_block_list.text:
On this day, as the newly appointed PR 
ambassador for the resort hotel, 
Maruzensky attended a meeting for the 
renewal project.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what can we do to compete with the 
neighboring hotels trending on social 
media...?

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff A
text_block_list.text:
What customers want is definitely novelty! 
We need to stop relying on our prestige as 
a historic family retreat and make various 
changes!

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we take inspiration from stores 
buzzing on Umastagram? First, make the 
lobby much flashier—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* It's no use... Our budget isn't 
nearly enough... Where on earth do we even 
begin...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hey, everyone! The discussion has 
gotten quite heated, so how about taking a 
little refresher?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's treat ourselves to a stylish coffee 
break! I know a great place nearby!

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! If it's a modern cafe, we can 
get some great ideas for the interior and 
photogenic sweets!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiiya! Master, sorry to barge in on ya! 
Can we get everyone the usual coffee?

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... how should I put this, this 
shop has quite a lot of years on it...

text_block_list.name: Coffee Shop Master
text_block_list.text:
Here you are, sorry for the wait on the 
coffee. Please take your time and relax.

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes, thank you. Well then, down the 
hatch—...?!

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff A
text_block_list.text:
D-Delicious...! There's no unpleasant 
aftertaste at all... The balance of 
bitterness and sweetness is simply 
exquisite...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
See, pretty groovy, right?♪ You know, the 
coffee here is roasted in-house by the 
master himself!

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff A
text_block_list.text:
I see... But just roasting in-house 
wouldn't produce a flavor like this on its 
own... Is it the heat level...? No, the 
humidity?

text_block_list.name: Coffee Shop Master
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's everything. We adjust the 
brewing process for each and every bean 
before serving.

text_block_list.name: Coffee Shop Master
text_block_list.text:
As for the beans themselves, we buy them 
directly from overseas plantations. If 
that dedication comes through in the 
taste, I couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff A
text_block_list.text:
No, this is truly the ultimate cup...! To 
think a cup of coffee could move me this 
deeply...

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff B
text_block_list.text:
Going this far with such dedication... 
It's truly incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You know, I saw it on TV recently, 
apparently retro coffee shops aren't 
'trendy' anymore.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's true that brand-new things catch 
people's eyes. But, what we really need to 
cherish is—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You noticed the master's dedication the 
moment you took a sip of his coffee, so 
I'm sure you understand, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff Members
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff A
text_block_list.text:
...Finding something that touches the 
heart, committing to it relentlessly, and 
polishing it to perfection...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's old, even if it looks 
outdated, something that makes your heart 
skip a beat is genuinely 'trendy'!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why retro coffee shops will always 
be totally trendy to me♪

text_block_list.name: Resort Staff B
text_block_list.text:
We had completely forgotten what was truly 
important, hadn't we...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone, let's head back and 
resume the meeting! Let's discuss once 
more how we can make our guests' hearts 
flutter!

One day, while walking through the 
academy—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiiya! You over there! The prestigious 
seaside resort has had a total makeover! 
I'm handing out invitations to the 
pre-opening event~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzen's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
"Maruzen-senpai! Please give me a flyer!" 
"One for me too!!" "Maruzen-san, over 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! All right! Time for a 
little podium dance to hype it up even 
more~!

text_block_list.name: Student
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a resort, you say? It sounds like a 
hidden gem, maybe I'll go check it out.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, mission accomplished! Let's keep 
this momentum going and get the word out 
big time!
